user_request: run the remaining six plans in parallel with the first six (12 concurrent) but monitor; if CPU or anything overloads, revert
change: concurrent workers 6 -> 12; GPUs shared between two of our workers
implementation: supervisor stopped (workers unaffected); R-TB-SG-ABS-1, NC-1, E-2, B2-2, ABS-2, NC-2 started through the unchanged CLI train path under in-process overrides (MAX_WORKERS=12, ledger shared-GPU refusal skipped); tracked source, HEAD, release unchanged
revert_mechanism: sg_concurrency_guard.py sends SIGSTOP to the six extra workers when load1>75, MemAvailable<30 GiB or any GPU memory>36000 MiB and SIGCONT after 10 consecutive good samples (load1<45, MemAvailable>60 GiB, GPU<30000 MiB); this is the 6-wide schedule without losing a run
note: simulated-time budgets (Tcap/Ncap) are independent of wall time; only wall-clock concurrency differs
